### 2026-10-10 – I finished making the PCB for the starbie board. I use my school chromebook so I used pcbjam in my browser instead of actual kidcad. It didn't let me import any images to the design.

**2h**

I finished making the PCB for the starbie board. I use my school chromebook so I used pcbjam in my browser instead of actual kidcad. It didn't let me import any images to the design.

![Screenshot 2026-10-10 2.26.47 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CNY2HZ9OcTankKg1g6KDuwLwC2Pp0VCI/16a9851ab1fc70f4e7ac4a87ad8e71d44a7757e6bbc52bcb4d417fd651264d41.png)

Then i added the .cpp file for the microcontroller and I drew this as the pet.

![pixil-frame-0](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CNY2HZ9OcTankKg1g6KDuwLwC2Pp0VCI/a26e4f797085bc216855119e331a79c7f09091fdb06faeef1945a7b1047d6dc7.png)

I'm new to PCB so the routing took me a lot of time. I didn't even know about Via's until someone told me in lapse.  I moved the components around over and over until it was possible. I had some trouble importing the footprint libraries and the symbols.
